declarations.name: Research.BinaryTreeReduction.roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
declarations.type:
∀ (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (tree : Research.BinaryTreeReduction.Tree.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Real Real)),
  LT.lt.{0}
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.Tree.depth.{0} tree) 1))
        (Research.FloatingPoint.Model.u model))
      1 →
    ∃ perturbed,
      And
        (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.IsPerturbation
          (Research.FloatingPoint.gamma (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.Tree.depth.{0} tree) 1)
            (Research.FloatingPoint.Model.u model))
          (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.exactProductTree tree) perturbed)
        (Eq.{1} (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.Tree.exactSum perturbed)
          (Research.BinaryTreeReduction.roundedDotProduct model tree))
